mapper.select: SELECT LEVEL AS LVL, C.CATEGORY_ID, C.PARENT_ID, C.CATEGORY_NM, SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(C.CATEGORY_NM, '>') AS PATH FROM TB_CATEGORY C WHERE C.USE_YN = 'Y' START WITH C.PARENT_ID IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR C.CATEGORY_ID = C.PARENT_ID ORDER SIBLINGS BY C.SORT_NO
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_STOCK S USING (SELECT #{productId} AS PRODUCT_ID, 'W01' AS WAREHOUSE_CD, #{qty} AS QTY FROM DUAL) D ON (S.PRODUCT_ID = D.PRODUCT_ID AND S.WAREHOUSE_CD = D.WAREHOUSE_CD) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET S.STOCK_QTY = S.STOCK_QTY + D.QTY, S.UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PRODUCT_ID, WAREHOUSE_CD, STOCK_QTY, SAFE_QTY, UPD_DT) VALUES (D.PRODUCT_ID, D.WAREHOUSE_CD, D.QTY, 0, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NM, S.STOCK_QTY, S.SAFE_QTY FROM TB_PRODUCT P, TB_STOCK S WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID AND S.STOCK_QTY < S.SAFE_QTY ORDER BY S.STOCK_QTY) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NM, X.SALES_QTY FROM TB_PRODUCT P, (SELECT I.PRODUCT_ID, SUM(I.QTY) AS SALES_QTY FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM I, TB_ORDER O WHERE I.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID AND O.ORDER_STATUS != '90' GROUP BY I.PRODUCT_ID) X WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = X.PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY X.SALES_QTY DESC

INSERT INTO TB_PRODUCT (PRODUCT_ID, CATEGORY_ID, PRODUCT_NM, PRICE, STATUS_CD, REG_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{productId}, #{categoryId}, #{productNm}, #{price}, 'SALE', #{regId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE)
